'''Via''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. She worked in the [[Animal Circle]]. Friends of [[V-Nen|Nen]] and [[O-Melie|Melie]], she taught their adopted son [[V-Davi|Davi]] how to care for animals in the Circle.
